reason: The lab report and named lab are good, but $25 to $30 a month is too much when I watch every dollar. I can find magnesium for less and I would rather pick something with several forms in it.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products put 8 forms in one capsule? I would be paying more for a single form.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $15 a month, or a trial box at that price, with the lab report showing the actual tested dose per capsule.
